author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Refik Anadol Studio
summary: An art studio in Los Angeles since 2014. It uses large datasets, machine learning and architectural surfaces to create moving abstract environments in which computation becomes visible form.

hero_image.alt: A long table of dark-field prints, translucent blocks and small massing models in a bright studio, with two people working at the pinned wall behind.
hero_image.caption: Data given a body: the image tested as a printed and physical object, not only on a screen.
